_comment: Which blank to use for each product, and which artwork goes where.
catalogProductId / catalogVariantId are Printful CATALOG ids (not store ids).
Variant ids are left empty until confirmed against the live catalog — a wrong
variant id silently prints the wrong garment, so this file does not guess
them. Fill them from GET /products/{id} once, and they are correct forever.
placements map a Printful file type to artwork in public/store/print/.
'default' is a DTG front print; 'back' is the large back print;

products.name: The Signature Cap
products.notes: Embroidery. Printful digitises the PNG themselves; do not supply a stitch file.

products.name: The Everyday Tee
products.notes: Front left chest is small (emblem only); back is the full lockup.

products.name: The Connection Hoodie
products.notes: Same as the tee until the elaborate back art exists.

products.name: The Connection Windbreaker
products.notes: Confirm the blank has a back print area before ordering.

products.name: The Connect Sticker Set
products.notes: Sticker products take a single print file.

products.name: The Connect Pick Set
products.notes: PrintKK fulfils picks, not Printful. Leave this entry empty unless that changes.
